question: The male and female literacy rates in 2011 Census were recorded as ____% and ____%, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**82.14; 65.46.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2011 Census:-**

 
 
• **​House listing** and **population enumeration** were the two phases of the **15th Indian Census**, which took place in **2011**.
 
• The gathering of data regarding each and every building was part of the House listing phase, which began on** April 1, 2010.**
 
• Between** February 9** and **February 28, 2011**, the second phase of population enumeration was carried out.
 
• India has had a census every year **since 1872**, but** biometric data **were only collected in 2011.
 
• The population of India **increased** to **1.21 billion** as of** March 31, 2011**, according to preliminary reports, representing a **17.70% annual growth rate.**
 
• With a** decadal growth rate of 9.21 percent**, the adult **literacy rate** reached **74.04%**. **"Our Census, Our Future"** was the census's motto.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate** 

 
 
• The percentage of people who are able to **read and write **is measured by the literacy rate. **Adult literacy rates** (those over the age of 15) and **youth literacy rates** (those between the ages of 15 and 24) further subdivide the literacy rate.
 
• In addition to academic achievement, India's literacy rate is one of the most important factors for **socioeconomic advancement.**
 
 

 
 

 Literacy Rate in Urban Areas of India
 87.7%
 
 

 Literacy Rate in Rural Areas of India
 73.5%
